description: Claim proofs (kind 23198, K-CLAIM-1..5) and their verification, NIP-IC attestations, cash targets, the requests nmilat builds for cash_redeem, cash_transfer and cash_consolidate, their results (tokens decrypted, tombstones), tombstone reasons, ordered inheritance, and finding the caller's own row (ownRow) and whether it can be spent (claimable).
